_provenance: Local events per market, hand-kept until the pages move to thebinaschool.com (its Cal.com sync reads team 243242, slugs local-{market}-…, Juli hosts). An event moves from Upcoming to Past the day after its date, at build time; nothing is ever deleted. Upcoming events carry `date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `rsvp` (the Cal.com booking link); hand-added past events carry `year` + `month`. A past card shows title · area · month + year · photo (never the exact day or time). Location rule: a public venue shows venue + date; a small or private venue shows the area only; a family's home never. Photos: alt = place + activity + season, never kids' names.
